items.title: Donn Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 6, 2009
items.q: I once, I think I was talking to Phil and I said, “You know, why don’t we go buy a used hearse? It’s big, you could fit the whole band in there..."

ctx.x: Do you remember what your tuition was in those years?

Let’s see. The figure 7 hundred dollars for tuition strikes a bell. And that, coupled with the room and board, which was a whole different billing, ended up to be around 11 hundred, 12 hundred dollars. And I was on a half tuition scholarship, and I had a job in the fraternity the whole time I was here doing one thing or another. So it was about eleven hundred, and as Phil said today in his speech, next year’s tuition and board and room is 49 thousand. That’s a hunk of change. But even then you know, 11 hundred…
Is there something you got from Hamilton that you can put into words that really made a difference for you in your career?
